insights.one_liner: Together AI is a US AI cloud for developers, used by Cursor, ElevenLabs and Zoom, with a senior engineering role in Amsterdam; not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Together AI runs a cloud for AI engineers offering inference, fine-tuning and pre-training on open models, serving 400+ trillion tokens a month.
Customers include Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce and Zoom.

open.text: Together AI is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a senior software engineering role in Amsterdam, needs no Dutch and drew about 126 LinkedIn applicants.

growth.text: IBM and Together AI signed a $240 million multi-year deal for a large NVIDIA B300 inference cluster.
It formed partnerships to build AI infrastructure with HUMAIN in Saudi Arabia and Mubadala in the UAE.
Larsen & Toubro is building a large AI cluster for Together AI in Chennai, India.

worth_knowing.text: It is looking to capacity in Saudi Arabia partly to sidestep US backlash over data centres.
